name: ReLU$^2$ (PyTorch)
tagline: Custom torch.autograd.Function: linear $\to$ ReLU$^2$ $\to$ linear with hand-rolled backward saving the pre-activation.
diff_from_baseline: So et al. 2021 (Primer). Squared-ReLU MLP activation; here implemented as a custom torch.autograd.Function that saves only the pre-activation and ReLU output to make backward cheaper than autograd's default. No Triton.

name: Triton GELU MLP
tagline: Triton elementwise kernel for tanh-approx GELU between two PyTorch matmuls; analytical FP32 backward.
diff_from_baseline: Tillet et al. 2019 (Triton). Drop-in tanh-GELU MLP that runs the activation through a custom Triton kernel between PyTorch matmuls; backward computes the analytical GELU gradient in FP32 to avoid bf16 precision loss.

name: Triton fused linear+ReLU$^2$
tagline: Triton matmul kernel that fuses $xW_{fc}^\top$ with ReLU$^2$ and saves the pre-activation for a custom backward.
diff_from_baseline: modded-nanoGPT-style fused squared-ReLU MLP. Triton kernel computes $\mathrm{ReLU}^2(xW_{fc}^\top)$ in one pass, avoiding materializing the bf16 intermediate; backward reuses the saved pre-activation.
